dedupe_keys.name: tiefliegende gebiete in hamburg mit hochwasserschutzanlagen

description: Tiefliegende Gebiete in Hamburg mit Hochwasserschutzanlagen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Representation of the terrain heights in the lowlands of Hamburg, the heights of the flood protection systems and the design storm flood underlying these heights. Representation of important buildings (e.g. lock, barrier) and logistically important facilities (sandbag hall, clothing store). Representation of the main traffic routes with indication of the road heights. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Low-lying areas in Hamburg with flood protection systems" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Höhe, ENVI. The listing shows 2007-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
